# A clause id in the wrong case

`Policy: pol-CASE` `DRAFT`

## Purpose

Clause ids are upper-case for the same reason document ids have one canonical casing: a citation is compared to
what the table carries, and two spellings of one id are two clauses as far as anything reading them is concerned.

## Scope

This fixture only. It exists so `clause-id-format` is exercised on its pattern branch.

## Clauses

| Id      | Clause                                               | Alignment |
|---------|------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| `clean` | **MUST** trigger `clause-id-format` and nothing else |           |
